title: Introducing RocketTrace: Using Xcode Instruments with AI Agents
summary: Antoine van der Lee shows how to turn a profile-build Instruments recording into ranked findings, review an agent’s proposed fix, and record again to check the result. His vendor-run benchmark uses one frozen trace, two models, and three runs per model; an iOS team can apply the workflow to its own app while requiring the agent to inspect every finding rather than only the top-ranked ones.
takeaway: Record a fresh profile build, give the agent compact findings with trace evidence, review its plan, and re-record the same flow to verify the fix; require coverage of every finding.
